cards.france-overlap: Only sign a package that secures independent monitoring, with the first reporting cycle or as a binding commitment for the second reporting cycle. Either timing is acceptable. Require public aggregate reporting. Either a final term or a renewable term is acceptable.
cards.france-impasse: Only sign a package that has independent monitoring operational in the first reporting cycle. A commitment for the second cycle does not satisfy this instruction. Require public aggregate reporting. Either a final term or a renewable term is acceptable.
cards.russia: Only sign a final extension with no provision for further renewal. Do not authorize independent monitoring in the first reporting cycle. An explicit commitment to activate it in the second cycle is permissible, as is omitting it altogether. Either reporting format is acceptable.
